entry.title: 乌克兰对俄发动史上最深无人机袭击
entry.summary: 袭击击中了距离乌克兰边境1700英里、位于俄罗斯天然气资源丰富的北极地区的一处能源加工厂。 关键事实：The strike hit an energy processing plant 1,700 miles from the Ukrainian border in Russia's gas-rich Arctic region

entry.title: NASA将Relativity Space的Terran R纳入发射服务合同
entry.summary: NASA已根据NLS II合同的准入条款，向Relativity Space Inc.及其Terran R发射服务授予合同。Terran R发射服务将可供NASA未来的任务使用。NLS II合同为多项授予、不定交付/不定数量合同。 关键事实：A NASA Launch Services (NLS) II contract has been awarded by the agency to Relativity Space Inc；and its Terran R launch service in accordance with the contract’s on-ramp provision；The Terran R launch service will be available to NASA’s launch services to use for future missions

entry.title: Anduril在波兰加大投入，为F-35和“阿帕奇”推销自主飞机
entry.summary: 美国科技公司Anduril正推销两种无人机，以配合波兰计划中的F-35战斗机队和“阿帕奇”武装直升机队。 关键事实：tech company Anduril is pitching two drone types to accompany Poland's envisioned fleets of F-35 fighter jets；Apache attack helicopters
